3: Pursuant to Article VI, Section IV of the Constitution of the State of Georgia, the City of East Dublin hereby enacts the following ordinance. “It shall be unlawful for any person to possess one ounce or less of marijuana within the corporate limits of the City of East Dublin.”
4: Conviction of the offense of possessing one ounce or less of marijuana shall be punishable by a fine not exceeding $1,000 or imprisonment not to exceed twelve (12) months, or any part of such punishment or combination thereof, or in any other manner consistent with the limits set forth in the City Charter.
